# NEW 2026-11-19 Yuan track Y5b (the Yuan princes, oe_yw_). Generated by gen_yuan_y5b.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Day-1 startup hook (matches oe_yp_after_lobby): registers the Yuan princes right after leaving the lobby
# so the Celestial panel shows 10 active princes on 1337-04-01 instead of waiting for the first monthly pulse.
# Guarded by global var oe_yw_init so save loads and oe_yw_monthly never double-run setup.
on_game_started_after_lobby = { on_actions = { oe_yw_after_lobby } }

oe_yw_after_lobby = {
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_init } }
            set_global_variable = oe_yw_init
            if = {
                limit = { current_date < 1337.6.1 }
                oe_yw_setup = yes
            }
            else = {
                debug_log = "oe_yw: not a new 1337 game, the line stays off"
            }
        }
    }
}
